verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents Playgrounds as a no-code workspace for iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets. You can run full evaluations in real time and compare results side by side, which covers the core of iterating on prompts against real models. Prompt template variables are never explicitly documented; dataset inputs only imply them, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt variables/templating in the playground, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Playgrounds provide a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets.
Run full evaluations in real-time, compare results side-by-side, and share configurations with teammates.
Measure and improve AI application quality with playgrounds and evals
